import { Design } from '@valenced/discord/design'
import { Clipboard } from '@valenced/externals/react-native-clipboard'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { ScrollView, View } from 'react-native'
import {
	addProfile,
	copyOf,
	deleteProfile,
	profileToJson,
	updateProfile,
} from './actions'
import { applySome, standingOf } from './apply'
import {
	REPEATS,
	showsTimer,
	STANDING_TEXT,
	TIME_MODES,
	TYPES,
	WEEKDAYS_SHORT,
} from './constants'
import Field from './Field'
import Preview, { describe } from './Preview'
import { toast } from './state'
import {
	clockText,
	dateText,
	parseClock,
	parseDate,
	relativeText,
} from './timers'
import { Back, block, group, radio, row, section, toggleRow } from './ui'
import { PARTY_MAX_SIZE, partyProblem } from './variables'
import { warnings } from './warnings'
import type { Profile, RichPresenceSettings } from './types'

/** The longest a group size can be typed: the digits of the biggest size Discord takes. */
const PARTY_DIGITS = String(PARTY_MAX_SIZE).length

/** What a date field says it understood, so a mistake is clear before anything is sent. */
export function readsDate(value: unknown): string {
	if (!String(value || '').trim())
		return 'Type a date and time, such as 2026-12-25 18:30.'
	const date = parseDate(value)
	return date === undefined
		? 'Not a date yet. Try 2026-12-25 18:30.'
		: `Reads as ${dateText(date)} (${relativeText(date)}).`
}

/** What a time of day field says it understood. */
export function readsClock(value: unknown): string {
	if (!String(value || '').trim()) return 'Type a time, such as 9:00 or 9pm.'
	const minutes = parseClock(value)
	return minutes === undefined
		? 'Not a time yet. Try 9:00 or 9pm.'
		: `Reads as ${clockText(minutes)}.`
}

/**
 * The editor of one custom presence, on one page you scroll down, like Kizzy's. The top shows how it will look. Below it each
 * part has a big title and one short line: Basics, Text, Group size, Images, Timer, Buttons, Schedule, Application ID,
 * Variables and Manage. Parts that only matter for a choice (the dates of a timer, the days of a schedule) appear when that
 * choice is made. Every text box saves a moment after typing stops.
 *
 * @param profile The presence being edited.
 * @param settings The settings, for the reasons it is or is not shown.
 * @param onBack Goes back to the list.
 */
export default function EditProfile({
	profile,
	settings,
	onBack,
}: {
	profile: Profile
	settings: RichPresenceSettings
	onBack: () => void
}) {
	const [draft, setDraft] = useState<{ id: string; values: Partial<Profile> }>({
		id: '',
		values: {},
	})
	const live: Profile = Object.assign(
		{},
		profile,
		draft.id === profile.id ? draft.values : {},
	)

	/** Remembers what is being typed in a field, so the preview and the notes follow it. */
	const onDraft = (key: keyof Profile, value: string) =>
		setDraft(prev => {
			const next = Object.assign(
				{},
				prev.id === profile.id ? prev.values : {},
			) as Record<string, unknown>
			next[key] = value
			return { id: profile.id, values: next as Partial<Profile> }
		})

	const update = (patch: Partial<Profile>, reset?: boolean) =>
		updateProfile(profile.id, patch, reset)

	const field = (
		key: keyof Profile & string,
		label: string,
		placeholder: string,
		description: string,
		maxLength: number,
	) => (
		<Field
			key={`${profile.id}:${key}`}
			label={label}
			placeholder={placeholder}
			description={description}
			maxLength={maxLength}
			value={profile[key] as string}
			onDraft={value => onDraft(key, value)}
			onCommit={value =>
				update(
					{ [key]: value } as Partial<Profile>,
					key.startsWith('timer') ||
						key.startsWith('custom') ||
						key.startsWith('countdown') ||
						key.startsWith('daily'),
				)
			}
		/>
	)

	const mine = warnings(settings).filter(w => w.id === profile.id)
	const mode = profile.timestampMode
	const days =
		Array.isArray(profile.scheduleDays) && profile.scheduleDays.length === 7
			? profile.scheduleDays
			: [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]

	/** The group size notes follow what is typed, like Kizzy's red lines under its boxes. */
	const partyNow = partyProblem('current', live.partyCurrent, live.partyMax)
	const partyMaxNote = partyProblem('max', live.partyCurrent, live.partyMax)

	const parts = [
		mine.length
			? section(
					'Fix this',
					undefined,
					...mine.map((w, i) => row(`⚠ Problem ${i + 1}`, w.text)),
				)
			: null,

		block(
			'Basics',
			STANDING_TEXT[standingOf(settings, profile)],
			group(
				'basics',
				field(
					'label',
					'Name in the list',
					'My game',
					'Only you see this, in the list of presences.',
					40,
				),
				field(
					'name',
					'Activity name',
					'e.g. My game',
					'Required. The big title of the card. Nothing shows until you set it. Supports variables.',
					128,
				),
			),
			radio(
				'Kind of activity',
				profile.type,
				TYPES,
				type => update({ type }),
				'Discord shows only one Playing at a time. Make the others Listening to, Watching or Competing in so they can show together.',
			),
			profile.type === 1
				? group(
						'stream',
						field(
							'streamUrl',
							'Stream link',
							'https://twitch.tv/name',
							'A Twitch or YouTube link.',
							300,
						),
					)
				: null,
		),

		block(
			'Text',
			'The two lines under the title. They support variables.',
			group(
				'lines',
				field(
					'details',
					'Top line',
					'',
					'The first line, under the title.',
					128,
				),
				field('state', 'Bottom line', '', 'The second line.', 128),
			),
			group(
				'line-links',
				field(
					'detailsUrl',
					'Top line link',
					'https://',
					'Optional. Makes the top line tappable.',
					300,
				),
				field(
					'stateUrl',
					'Bottom line link',
					'https://',
					'Optional. Makes the bottom line tappable.',
					300,
				),
			),
		),

		block(
			'Group size',
			`Shows "1 of 4" on the card. Fill in both. Any whole number up to ${PARTY_MAX_SIZE}.`,
			group(
				'party',
				field(
					'partyCurrent',
					'In the group now',
					'1',
					partyNow ?? 'How many are in the group.',
					PARTY_DIGITS,
				),
				field(
					'partyMax',
					'Group size',
					'4',
					partyMaxNote ?? 'How many fit in the group.',
					PARTY_DIGITS,
				),
			),
		),

		block(
			'Images',
			'Paste any link you could post in chat, or an asset key from your application.',
			group(
				'large',
				field(
					'largeImage',
					'Large image',
					'https://… or asset key',
					'The square picture. Imgur links and pages with a picture work too. If one fails, try a smaller image.',
					300,
				),
				field(
					'largeText',
					'Large image text',
					'',
					'Shown when the picture is pressed.',
					128,
				),
				field(
					'largeUrl',
					'Large image link',
					'https://',
					'Optional. Opened when the picture is tapped.',
					300,
				),
			),
			group(
				'small',
				field(
					'smallImage',
					'Small image',
					'https://… or asset key',
					'A small picture in the corner of the large one.',
					300,
				),
				field(
					'smallText',
					'Small image text',
					'',
					'Shown when the picture is pressed.',
					128,
				),
				field(
					'smallUrl',
					'Small image link',
					'https://',
					'Optional. Opened when the picture is tapped.',
					300,
				),
			),
			group(
				'image-tips',
				row(
					'Photos from your phone',
					'Upload the photo to catbox.moe or imgur.com, copy the link and paste it in Large image. Discord attachment links stop working after about a day.',
				),
				row(
					'Asset keys',
					'Upload art in your application on discord.com/developers under Rich Presence, type its name in the image box and set the Application ID.',
				),
			),
		),

		block(
			'Timer',
			showsTimer(live.type)
				? 'The timer shows under the lines on the card.'
				: `Discord shows no timer on a ${Number(live.type) === 1 ? 'Streaming' : 'Competing in'} card. Change the type to Playing, Listening to or Watching (Basics) for the timer to show.`,
			radio('What the timer does', mode, TIME_MODES, timestampMode =>
				update({ timestampMode }, true),
			),
			mode === 'since' || mode === 'until'
				? group(
						'timer-date',
						field(
							'timerDate',
							mode === 'since' ? 'Count up from' : 'Count down to',
							'2026-12-25 18:30',
							`${
								mode === 'since'
									? 'A date in the past.'
									: 'A date in the future.'
							} ${readsDate(live.timerDate)}`,
							40,
						),
					)
				: null,
			mode === 'until'
				? radio(
						'When the date has passed',
						profile.timerRepeat,
						REPEATS,
						timerRepeat => update({ timerRepeat }, true),
					)
				: null,
			mode === 'countdown'
				? group(
						'countdown',
						field(
							'countdownMinutes',
							'Minutes',
							'30',
							'How long it counts down from when the presence is switched on.',
							6,
						),
						toggleRow(
							'Start over when it ends',
							'Counts down the same time again and again',
							!!profile.countdownLoop,
							countdownLoop => update({ countdownLoop }, true),
						),
					)
				: null,
			mode === 'daily'
				? group(
						'daily',
						field(
							'dailyFrom',
							'Every day from',
							'9:00',
							`A progress bar that shows while it is in range. ${readsClock(live.dailyFrom)}`,
							8,
						),
						field(
							'dailyTo',
							'Every day to',
							'17:00',
							`${readsClock(live.dailyTo)} A time earlier than the first runs past midnight.`,
							8,
						),
					)
				: null,
			mode === 'custom'
				? group(
						'custom',
						field(
							'customStart',
							'Start',
							'2026-01-01 12:00',
							`A start counts up. ${readsDate(live.customStart)}`,
							40,
						),
						field(
							'customEnd',
							'End',
							'',
							`An end counts down. Set both and the same length starts over again and again. ${readsDate(live.customEnd)}`,
							40,
						),
					)
				: null,
		),

		block(
			'Buttons',
			'A button needs a label and a link. Other people see them; Discord does not show them on your own profile.',
			group(
				'button1',
				field('button1Label', 'Button 1 label', 'Listen along', '', 32),
				field('button1Url', 'Button 1 link', 'https://', '', 300),
			),
			group(
				'button2',
				field('button2Label', 'Button 2 label', '', '', 32),
				field('button2Url', 'Button 2 link', 'https://', '', 300),
			),
		),

		block(
			'Schedule',
			'Show this presence only on some days and between some times. Outside them it is taken off your profile by itself.',
			group(
				'schedule-on',
				toggleRow(
					'Use a schedule',
					'Off means it shows whenever it is switched on',
					!!profile.scheduleOn,
					scheduleOn => update({ scheduleOn }),
				),
			),
			profile.scheduleOn
				? group(
						'schedule',
						<View
							key="days"
							style={{
								flexDirection: 'row',
								flexWrap: 'wrap',
								gap: 8,
								paddingVertical: 8,
							}}
						>
							{WEEKDAYS_SHORT.map((name, i) => (
								<Design.Button
									key={name}
									text={name}
									variant={days[i] ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
									size="sm"
									onPress={() =>
										update({
											scheduleDays: days.map((d, j) => (j === i ? !d : d)),
										})
									}
								/>
							))}
						</View>,
						field(
							'scheduleFrom',
							'From',
							'9:00',
							readsClock(live.scheduleFrom),
							8,
						),
						field(
							'scheduleTo',
							'To',
							'17:00',
							`${readsClock(live.scheduleTo)} A time earlier than From runs past midnight.`,
							8,
						),
					)
				: null,
			group(
				'only-when',
				field(
					'showOnlyWhen',
					'Show only when this has text',
					'{sc_title}',
					'Optional. Hides this presence while the text comes out empty. {sc_title} hides it when no SoundCloud track is playing.',
					128,
				),
			),
		),

		block(
			'Application ID',
			'Needed to show more than one presence at once. Each presence needs a different one.',
			group(
				'app-id',
				field(
					'applicationId',
					'Application ID',
					'Leave empty for a made-up one',
					'Leave it empty and one is made up for you. Only type one for image asset keys: create an application at discord.com/developers and paste its ID. The same ID in two presences makes Discord show them as one.',
					24,
				),
			),
		),

		block(
			'Variables',
			'Use these in any text box. They update on the refresh interval.',
			group(
				'variables',
				row(
					'{time} {time12} {seconds} {date} {day} {month} {year} {user} {username} {uptime}',
					'SoundCloud: {sc_title} {sc_artist} {sc_url} {sc_art} {sc_button}',
				),
			),
		),

		block(
			'Manage',
			undefined,
			group(
				'manage',
				row('Show this now', 'Send it again and restart its timer', () => {
					applySome([profile.id], true)
					toast('Presence applied')
				}),
				row('Duplicate', 'Make a copy of this presence', () => {
					addProfile(copyOf(profile))
					toast('Copy added')
				}),
				row(
					'Copy as text',
					'Copy it so it can be pasted on another phone',
					() => {
						Clipboard.setString(profileToJson(profile))
						toast('Presence copied')
					},
				),
				row('Delete', 'Remove this presence for good', () => {
					deleteProfile(profile.id).then(ok => {
						if (ok) onBack()
						else toast('Keep at least one presence')
					})
				}),
			),
		),
	]

	return (
		<ScrollView
			style={{ flex: 1 }}
			contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 38 }}
			stickyHeaderIndices={[0]}
			keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
		>
			<Preview info={describe(live)} profileId={profile.id} />
			<Design.Stack
				style={{ paddingVertical: 24, paddingHorizontal: 12 }}
				spacing={32}
			>
				<Back title="All presences" onPress={onBack} />
				{parts}
			</Design.Stack>
		</ScrollView>
	)
}
constants.ts:
import type {
	Choice,
	Repeat,
	SoundCloudSettings,
	Standing,
	StatusText,
	TimerMode,
	TimestampMode,
} from './types'

/** The prefix of the plugin's log lines. */
export const TAG = '[rich-presence]'

/**
 * The fake sockets and processes the presences are sent as. Discord's local activity store keeps one activity for each
 * socket, so each profile that is shown gets its own: `EskimoRichPresence:<profile id>`, with the next process number.
 */
export const SOCKET_PREFIX = 'EskimoRichPresence:'
export const PID_BASE = 1337

/** The id of the toasts this plugin shows. */
export const TOAST_KEY = 'ESKIMO_RICH_PRESENCE'

/**
 * How many presences can be shown at once by default, and the most the setting allows. Three is as many as Discord seems to
 * show on a profile.
 */
export const DEFAULT_MAX_ACTIVE = 3
export const MAX_ACTIVE_LIMIT = 3

/** How long to wait between sending one profile and the next, so Discord is not given a burst of presence updates (ms). */
export const SEND_GAP_MS = 400

/**
 * Discord turns an image link into a presence image through an application. Any valid application works for this, so it
 * is only the fallback when you set none of your own.
 */
export const IMAGE_APP_ID = '1054951789318909972'

/** The kinds of activity. */
export const TYPES: Choice<number>[] = [
	{ v: 0, l: 'Playing', s: 'Only one Playing can show at a time' },
	{ v: 2, l: 'Listening to' },
	{ v: 3, l: 'Watching' },
	{ v: 5, l: 'Competing in', s: 'Discord shows no timer on it' },
	{
		v: 1,
		l: 'Streaming',
		s: 'Needs a Twitch or YouTube link. Discord shows no timer on it',
	},
]

/** The activity types Discord shows a timer on: Playing, Listening to and Watching. Streaming and Competing in have none. */
export const TIMER_TYPES = [0, 2, 3]

/** Whether Discord shows the timer of a presence of this type. */
export const showsTimer = (type: unknown): boolean =>
	TIMER_TYPES.includes(Number(type))

/** The kinds of timer, each with a line that says what it does. */
export const TIME_MODES: Choice<TimestampMode>[] = [
	{ v: 'none', l: 'No timer', s: 'Nothing counts.' },
	{
		v: 'elapsed',
		l: 'Since switched on',
		s: 'Counts up from when this presence was switched on or applied.',
	},
	{
		v: 'app',
		l: 'Since Discord opened',
		s: 'Counts up from when you opened Discord.',
	},
	{
		v: 'since',
		l: 'Since a date',
		s: 'Counts up from a date you pick, such as "days since" something.',
	},
	{
		v: 'until',
		l: 'Until a date',
		s: 'Counts down to a date. It can start over every day, week, month or year.',
	},
	{
		v: 'countdown',
		l: 'Countdown',
		s: 'Counts down a number of minutes. It can start over each time it runs out.',
	},
	{ v: 'midnight', l: 'Until midnight', s: 'Counts down the rest of today.' },
	{
		v: 'clock',
		l: 'Time of day',
		s: 'Counts up from midnight, so it reads like the clock.',
	},
	{
		v: 'daily',
		l: 'Between two times each day',
		s: 'A progress bar from one time to another, every day.',
	},
	{
		v: 'custom',
		l: 'Start and end',
		s: 'Your own start and end. With both set, the same length starts over again and again.',
	},
	{
		v: 'external',
		l: 'From the SoundCloud track',
		s: 'The start and end of the track the SoundCloud presence is showing.',
	},
]

/** How a date repeats. */
export const REPEATS: Choice<Repeat>[] = [
	{ v: 'none', l: 'Never', s: 'Once the date has passed, the timer stops.' },
	{ v: 'daily', l: 'Every day', s: 'Goes to the same time tomorrow.' },
	{
		v: 'weekly',
		l: 'Every week',
		s: 'Goes to the same day and time next week.',
	},
	{ v: 'monthly', l: 'Every month', s: 'Goes to the same day next month.' },
	{ v: 'yearly', l: 'Every year', s: 'For birthdays and the like.' },
]

/** The names of the days, Sunday first, and the same shortened. */
export const WEEKDAYS = [
	'Sunday',
	'Monday',
	'Tuesday',
	'Wednesday',
	'Thursday',
	'Friday',
	'Saturday',
]
export const WEEKDAYS_SHORT = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat']

/** The fields of a profile that are copied, pasted and exported (everything except its id and whether it is on). */
export const PROFILE_KEYS = [
	'label',
	'name',
	'type',
	'details',
	'detailsUrl',
	'state',
	'stateUrl',
	'applicationId',
	'streamUrl',
	'largeImage',
	'largeUrl',
	'largeText',
	'smallImage',
	'smallUrl',
	'smallText',
	'timestampMode',
	'customStart',
	'customEnd',
	'countdownMinutes',
	'countdownLoop',
	'timerDate',
	'timerRepeat',
	'dailyFrom',
	'dailyTo',
	'partyCurrent',
	'partyMax',
	'button1Label',
	'button1Url',
	'button2Label',
	'button2Url',
	'showOnlyWhen',
	'scheduleOn',
	'scheduleDays',
	'scheduleFrom',
	'scheduleTo',
] as const

/** The names of days and months for the `{day}` and `{month}` variables. */
export const DAYS = WEEKDAYS
export const MONTHS = [
	'January',
	'February',
	'March',
	'April',
	'May',
	'June',
	'July',
	'August',
	'September',
	'October',
	'November',
	'December',
]

/** Links that end like a picture are used as they are. */
export const IMAGE_TYPES = /\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|avif|bmp)(\?|#|$)/i

/** How long a change in the settings waits before the presence is sent, so typing sends it once (milliseconds). */
export const APPLY_DELAY_MS = 200

/** How long a text field waits after typing before it saves (milliseconds). */
export const FIELD_COMMIT_MS = 300

/** The shortest refresh interval (seconds). */
export const MIN_REFRESH_SECONDS = 15

/** How long after Discord reconnects the presence is sent again (milliseconds). Discord drops local activities on reconnect. */
export const RECONNECT_DELAY_MS = 3000

/** The most characters of a button label. */
export const MAX_BUTTON_LABEL = 32

/// SOUNDCLOUD

/** SoundCloud's orange, used in the preview. */
export const ORANGE = '#FF5500'

/** How many recent tracks are kept. */
export const MAX_RECENTS = 8

/** A SoundCloud link, anywhere in a text. */
export const LINK_RE =
	/https?:\/\/(?:www\.|m\.|on\.)?soundcloud\.com\/[^\s<>"')]+/i

/** The hash of the empty picture Last.fm sends when it has no cover. */
export const LASTFM_BLANK = '2a96cbd8b46e442fc41c2b86b821562f'

/** The variables the custom profiles can use to show the SoundCloud track. */
export const RICH_VARS = [
	'sc_title',
	'sc_artist',
	'sc_url',
	'sc_art',
	'sc_button',
]

/**
 * Discord allows a client 5 presence updates per 20 seconds. Four of the SoundCloud presence's are sent inside any 20 seconds,
 * so a song change goes out at once and only a long burst has to wait. Repeats of the same update are dropped.
 */
export const RATE_MAX = 4
export const RATE_WINDOW_MS = 20000

/** A stuck request must not block the next check. */
export const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000

/** When a track with a known length ends, Last.fm is asked right away what plays next (this long after the end). */
export const END_POLL_GRACE_MS = 1000

/** The shortest time between two checks of Last.fm (seconds). */
export const MIN_POLL_SECONDS = 5

/** Between two songs Last.fm can briefly report nothing. One quick second look stops the status flickering off. */
export const MISS_RECHECK_MS = 8000

/** How long after opening Discord the clipboard is looked at (milliseconds). */
export const CLIPBOARD_AT_START_MS = 2000
export const CLIPBOARD_ON_RETURN_MS = 800

/** How long after Spotify changes the SoundCloud presence is checked (milliseconds). */
export const SPOTIFY_DELAY_MS = 1500

/** Shown as the cover when no real one can be found. It lives in this plugin's folder in the repository. */
export const FALLBACK_COVER =
